name: Hlk Fm22X → On Enrollment Failed
description:
An action to be performed when a face enrollment step failed. See [`on_enrollment_failed`](https://esphome.io/components/hlk_fm22x/#on_enrollment_failed-trigger).

With this configuration option you can write complex automations whenever a face failed to be enrolled. To use the variable, use a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates) template, the error number is available inside that lambda under the variable named `error`.
